messages:
oliver: Deploy-bot paused the promotion during the change window. Reason: cache index miss + smoke test DB init timeout. CI: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/200201 :eyes:
deploy-bot: Promotion paused: reason=cache_index_miss, artifact=api-gateway@sha256:d4c3b2a1, auto_retries=2
oliver: failing logs:
```
WARN cache: index key not found: artifacts/api-gateway/sha256:d4c3b2a1
ERROR smoke-test[db-init]: timed out waiting for testdb socket (30s)
```
sanaa: Is this mirror-region or primary? Mirror lag tends to cause temporary 404/miss. If mirror catches up in ~90s it usually clears.
devops-lead: Change window ends in 14m. Options: (1) short hold 5m and auto-retry, (2) manual-promote last-known-good to avoid missing window, (3) full rerun (long). Risk?
ci-bot: Last-known-good for api-gateway is sha256:9f8e7d6c promoted 2.5h ago. Unit+integration green; smoke flaky historically when testdb infra hits port collisions.
release-coordinator: I'm leaning manual-pin to keep window. We must annotate release notes and open a follow-up to rerun the original build post-window.
sanaa: +1 to manual-pin. Please include note: "Pinned to previous artifact due to transient cache propagation; follow-up CI rerun scheduled."
devops-lead: OK running promote: `deployctl promote --artifact api-gateway@sha256:9f8e7d6c --target=stable --reason "cache propagation; smoke flake" --annotate "manual pin; follow-up TICKET-8243"`
deploy-bot: Promotion executed by devops-lead. stable -> api-gateway@sha256:9f8e7d6c. Note added to release metadata.
oliver: Change window unblocked. Creating TICKET-8243 to investigate cache indexing and mirror propagation; scheduling CI rerun for original build at +30m.
ci-bot: Follow-up actions: 1) rerun CI for original build after window, 2) if rerun passes and artifact validates, consider re-promote in next window; 3) otherwise prepare hotfix plan.
release-coordinator: I'll update release notes with the pin and TICKET-8243 link. Closing thread "."
